We work with businesses in Limerick and across Ireland; most of the work is remote, and we meet Dublin clients in person.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR TECHNICAL SEO
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Technical SEO cost in Limerick?

Quoted per audit after a free review. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Limerick?
Yes. We work with businesses in Limerick and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
What does a technical SEO audit include?

Our audits cover crawlability, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, structured data, URL structure, internal linking, duplicate content, canonicalisation, hreflang (if applicable), robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and mobile usability.
How long does an audit take?
A comprehensive audit for a typical site takes 5–10 business days from kickoff to delivery. Larger sites (10,000+ pages) take 2–4 weeks.
Do you fix the issues too?
We can handle fixes ourselves or work with your development team. Audit-only engagements are available, or we can move into a full SEO retainer after the audit.
How much does a technical SEO audit cost?
Audits start at €750 for smaller sites and scale with site size and complexity. Enterprise audits are quoted individually.
